text:
marie: Heads up — noticed a customer hit repeated handback during a rollforward; operator inbox shows duplicates and latency spikes. Anyone seen this?
aj: saw it on staging yesterday. handback triggers are firing twice for the same request id when retry arrives. Possibly debounce not working.
sasha: Is the operator handback triggered by the policy or by the runtime? We changed debounce window to 50ms last week.
aj: runtime. debounce var in route-decider default 50ms. If KV cache misses, we end up re-evaluating and sending two events.
kevin: Customer reported audit log missing the second event (so ops can't tell why handback happened). telemetry shows 503 spikes around 12:03 UTC. :frowning: 
marie: Can we add event_id to operator notifications? Right now they only have route and trace_id.
sasha: we could add handback_event_id and parent_request_id, but that touches the notification schema used by console. UX concerns: operator inbox grouping could be noisy.
aj: Propose grouping in console by parent_request_id and de-dup within a 1s window. Also surface 'duplicate_handback' flag in the audit log.
devbot: deploy-bot: rolled out route-decider v2 to canary at 6212345600 by aj
kevin: :100: on de-dupe but also we need to preserve both events in audit — don't drop them. Maybe compress in UI but keep raw logs.
sasha: Agree. Implementation plan:
```
1) add event_id in notifications
2) emit both events to audit store with a relationship header
3) console shows collapsed view with expand for full list
```
marie: Timeline? This is priority for next sprint. Patch for the schema should be small.
aj: I'll put up a PR. Question: schema bump — do we use semver in telemetry? We have to coordinate with infra to migrate Kafka consumers.
kevin: Infra note: if we add new header 'handback_parent_id' as optional string, consumers should tolerate. But we should version the avro schema.
sasha: I'll sketch the avro change. UX mock: show collapsed card with '2 handbacks (1 suppressed) — expand to view timestamps and traces'.
marie: Also want a tooltip explaining 'suppressed' vs 'duplicate' vs 'intentional retry'
aj: Edgecase: if de-dupe window hides a real successive handback caused by separate failures. Maybe make window configurable per rollout.
kevin: Make default 1s but expose per-rollout configs: de_dup_ms = 1000.
sasha: I'll prototype and we can test on staging with synthetic spikes.
marie: Thanks. Can someone add a minimal runbook note for ops? Add to /runbooks/handback-duplicates.md
aj: Will do. PR link when ready.
devbot: ops-bot: created ticket #INF-2345 'handback dedupe and audit' assigned to aj
